description: This file contains Swagger API documentation annotations for the ClientsApiResource in the Fineract project. It defines schema annotations for request and response objects related to client management functionalities such as retrieving client data, creating, updating, and deleting clients. The classes provide structured representations of various API responses and request payloads, featuring detailed metadata annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ClientsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes representing Swagger schemas for client API responses and requests.
